title: Wasm Fmpq Matrix Operation Fallback
objective: Route exact rational matrix inverse and solve through packed kernels when optional generated resource operations are absent, preserving singular and consistent-system semantics

oracles: Sage-compatible exact inverse and solve identities across resource-present and operation-absent backends

handoff.summary: Exact QQ inverse and solve now probe their individual generated resource operations before dispatch. Resource-backed matrices use the declared packed FLINT kernels when Inv/Solve are absent; packed return status preserves singular inverse, consistent singular solve, and inconsistent-system semantics. The public regression includes the number-field equation-order identity repro and large rational operands.
risks: The final browser artifact must rebuild the baselib/package payload, but no C or Wasm relink is required.
next_steps: Integrate this commit and rerun the focused public fallback test plus the final WebKit number-field workload.
